description: Governor's Secretariat - Sabaragamuwa Province Under Section 27(a) of the Provincial Councils Act, No. 42 of 1987 First Supplementary Financial Statement
reasoning: This gazette notification deals exclusively with government structural and administrative changes - specifically the authorization of financial expenditures and amendments to the financial statement for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It grants permission to disburse funds and amend expenditure limits without naming any specific individuals or detailing personal portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on administrative functions, budgetary allocations, and the operational framework of the provincial council, which aligns with the definition of Organisational Gazettes (Type 1).
